duration.text: The Physical Electronics at Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 5694 USD/per year ￥ 41000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) 6. Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record. 7. Two recommendation letters From professor,associate professor or equivalents.

requirements.text: 1.Master's degree or equivalent or above with good marks. 2.Aged under 45 3.At least two recommendations of experts whose professional title is above professor; 4.Additional explanation: Applicants, who do not meet the above requirements, may be considered on an individual basis. They may be admitted as non-degree seeking students for one academic year. Those who pass the examinations held one year later will be automatically accepted as regular students. Those who fail will return to their home country as graduate students after completing some courses in a program.
